verdict.rationale: Incident management is a fair question for a monitoring platform, but the evidence shows no first-party way in Sentry to declare incidents, track incident timelines, run on-call schedules, or set escalation policies. What the pack does show is alert rules plus third-party integrations (PagerDuty paging, managing Sentry issues from incident.io). Those are adjacent features or external tools, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
